card.source: 46 cards across 23 distinct hero hands in 58 full-resolution 1440x2560 ADB frames from two LDPlayer instances, manually compared with the source frames; repeated temporal views of the same hand were not counted as independent accuracy samples. All 58 visible-hand frames read correctly (minimum accepted raw score 0.771). Eight login/transition/menu/result frames abstained with raw score 0.0. Card art templates are shared with WePoker H5; geometry and confidence evidence are Android-specific.
